A poem I stumbled across while testing out my website

It is horrible to think

but if we are to learn from mistakes, we will have to make them

billions could die

humanity will be shaken to its core

I may even be lost to no fault of my own

but if humanity survives, we will learn from our mistakes, and move forward as we always have, or perish

both are plausible choices, and the sad truth of life is you can't learn from the future, only past

to prevent the terrible from happening, you must witness what is terrible first. It is how we learn from our first relationships. It is how we learn from injury. It is how we grow as individuals. To grow as an individual is to grow as a species. To believe your existence is indicitive of the human experience is actually quite shallow, and sad. No two humans are the same, no two people experience the same events, react to these events the same. Every human is unique, and this in of itself means no human is special, no human is more human than another human.

Learn, grow, evolve. The faults of your fellow man will allow you to grow and learn from them, so long as you have the will to survive them. If shit hits the fan, I will do my best to survive, just as I already do in the current world. I will die because I failed to live, and that is quite okay. It would only be shameful, if I gave up instead. Horror will take many forms, but it is always present. Best to face it, stand up to it, show that it will not keep you from living, rather than ignore it, or try to change it. Because it will always be present, but it doesn't mean it has to control you.
